# the update, run until a pass changes nothing; that pass:
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # strip-a
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    what ran, in order:
        import ran
        parse ran on prices
        resolve ran on prices
        import ran
        parse ran on prices
        resolve ran on prices
        import ran
        parse ran on prices
        resolve ran on prices
        parse ran on plain
        resolve ran on plain
        parse ran on plain
        resolve ran on plain
